parameters.validator: Returns the error for the current text, or null when it is valid.
parameters.autovalidateMode: When the field checks itself: on each edit after the first, or only when its Form asks.
parameters.decoration: The label, helper and border; the error replaces the helper.
parameters.initialValue: The text the field starts with.
parameters.onSaved: Called with the text when the enclosing Form saves.
